name: wave-harness
description: Hooks and evidence tools for agent sessions that share one working tree: refuse irreversible git, warn on commands that answer truthfully and mean something else (a pipe that hides a red suite, a git grep blind to new files, a commit that swallows a neighbour's index), and record every gate run with an EXIT= its own shell printed. Repo-specific rules come from .claude/harness.toml.
